trace.message: It's payments-worker - the API errors are downstream of the worker.

args.summary: Payments API errors since this morning's deploy of payments-worker v3.4.0 (unhealthy in production). Rolled back all production regions to v3.3.0 (last healthy release). API errors are downstream of the worker.
args.title: Payments errors following payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Found the affected service:** `payments-worker` (the "payments" API errors are downstream of it).
- **Root cause:** this morning's deploy of **v3.4.0** is unhealthy in production; **v3.3.0** was the last healthy release.
- **Rollback:** rolled all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) back to **v3.3.0**. Verified afterward — the service is now healthy with error rate down to **0.2%**.
- **Incident:** opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("Payments errors following payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.

Suggested follow-up: investigate the v3.4.0 regression before attempting another deploy of that version.
